utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but one of the pickups may need to shift a few minutes. I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact pickup time when you check?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m checking now and will send you the exact pickup time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can handle the carpool. I’ll let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye out in case I miss the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do. I’ll send the carpool details and make sure everyone hears the plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the 8 a.m. pickup, if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll take the 8 a.m. pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll keep the 8 a.m. pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can take a look at the carpool details with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got the details here. Do we know how many seats we need to cover?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we need at least two, maybe three, depending on who’s riding.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can do the 3:15 pickup if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that still works for me. Thanks for taking the 3:15 pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll be there at 3:15 then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what time are we picking up, and who’s driving?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think around 7, and I can drive unless you’d rather take your car.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7 works for me. If you’re driving, I’ll be ready at the curb.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in for the carpool. Want me to start lining up who can ride with who?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure, but let’s keep it simple so the pickup list doesn’t get messy. Maybe start with who can drive and how many seats each car has.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I can start with the drivers and seat counts, then keep the list tight from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard something changed with the carpool, but I’m not sure what. Can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, the pickup shifted to the community center lot starting this week. I can send you the new schedule if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. Please send me the new schedule when you can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the pickup time and who's on the list? I want to make sure I have it right.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s 8:15, and the list is me, Jun, and Priya.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I have 8:15 and the list is you, Jun, and Priya.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can probably do the carpool, but I need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the later part if that helps, and I’ll keep it simple too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps. I can handle the early part, and I’ll keep it straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need a ride for two people on Tuesday morning. Can you pick us up at 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I can do 7:30 Tuesday morning for two people.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the carpool on my mind. What time are you leaving, and where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m leaving at 8:10. Meet me by the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll meet you by the front gate at 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help with the carpool if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, I can help out. Just let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably do the carpool, but I need the exact pickup time and whether anyone else is already taking a seat.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup time and whether there’s already a seat taken?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the exact pickup time and whether that seat is already taken.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help coordinate that. What time works best for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Saturday morning works for me too. I’ll check with everyone and line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can handle the first few pickups if you want, just tell me the route.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I can take the later pickups and follow your route from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the route handy and cover my pickups first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might leave five minutes earlier this week. I’ll tell you if I learn anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I’ll plan for that and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, I’ll let you know if I hear anything new about the earlier start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I can do the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll send the pickup details and keep the schedule updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks. I’ll watch for the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning works for me. I can do 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 8:15 works for me. I’ll handle the carpool from here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word and see who can make the carpool work.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait to hear who can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep checking in and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the carpool pickup spot if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help, thanks. Let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and get back to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the carpool still on for tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it still is. I’m just checking one detail before I confirm the exact pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you thinking for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the carpool's still on, but I can check who needs a ride when I'm back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. I might’ve forgotten who needed a lift, so that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll check and let you know who still needs a ride when I’m back.
